paragraphs.heading: 여담

quote_boxes.note: A faithful translation of the line.
quote_boxes.t_raw: 아, 제 의뢰를 보셨군요. 그럼, 혹시 그 Mist Flower Corolla 세 개를 가지고 계신가요?
quote_boxes.en: Ah, you must have seen that commission of mine. So, do you have those three Mist Flower Corollas handy?
